recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless the work group separately decides to reintroduce XPath constraint expressions.
issue_request: FHIR-15929 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition issue raised against STU3. It asked for compound invariant 8 on StructureDefinition.snapshot to be split because the base-definition half was not enforced in XPath, with a separate invariant for all snapshot elements having a base definition.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 4799a5bd47, which explicitly mentioned #15929 and changed the old StructureDefinition spreadsheet source by removing element.all(base.exists()) from sdf-8 and adding sdf-8b with FHIRPath element.all(base.exists()) plus XPath count(f:element) = count(f:element/f:base).
additional_context: StructureDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current migrated source keeps sdf-8 and sdf-8b as separate constraints. A later global cleanup, commit 88a1f3d6bd, removed XPath usage from ElementDefinition constraints, so the current absence of XPath is expected rather than a missed FHIR-15929 fix. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already preserves the substantive result of FHIR-15929 by enforcing the base-definition rule separately as sdf-8b with FHIRPath.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same 2018 application commit, but it concerned a different StructureDefinition/FHIRPath slicing fix and was not needed to decide FHIR-15929.
